신부 현지 · 신랑 병헌

Dear Everyone,

We are so happy to have found our lifelong partners in one another.

In lieu of a traditional wedding, we are celebrating our union with a simple family gathering. We ask for your kind blessings as we begin this new chapter.

Thank you for being a part of our lives and for your warm support from afar.

Sincerely, Hannah & Ben
